title: Gudanar da kasuwancin abinci mai aminci da riba

say: Gudanar da kasuwancin abinci mai aminci da riba.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 5 na Babban Dafa abinci da Gina Jiki: gudanar da kasuwancin abinci na gida da kayan abinci.
Yawancin masu sayar da abinci suna rasa abokan ciniki ba don abinci ba ne, amma saboda layin ya yi tsawo, ko abinci ya ƙare a gefe ɗaya na zauren.

say: Riƙe silinda gas a tsaye, a waje ko kuma a sami iska mai kyau, nesa da harshen wuta da baƙi. Duba hoses da haɗin gwiwa tare da ruwan sabulu. Kumfa na nufin zubewa. Kada a taɓa amfani da wuta don dubawa.
Ajiye abin kashe wuta da bargon wuta a wurin dafa abinci.

panel.heading: Gas da abinci mai zafi

cards.d: Silinda a tsaye, mai iska, nesa da harshen wuta da baƙi. Bincika magudanar ruwa da ruwan sabulu.
Kashe bawul ɗin, kashe duk wani wuta, kar a kunna ko kashewa, motsa mutane.
Sama da 60 C yayin sabis. Yi watsi da abinci daga sarrafa zafin jiki sama da awanni 2.

card.title: Farashi farantin soyayyen doya da kifi

say: Tabar gudummawar ita ce siyar da farashi rage farashin abinci. Rarraba kowane tasa da nawa aka sayar da ta gefe.
Tauraro ya shahara tare da babban gefe, don haka kiyaye shi daidai. Dokin garmama ya shahara tare da ƙaramin gefe. Ƙara farashin dan kadan ko yanke wani abu mai tsada.

panel.heading: Wadanne abinci ne suka fi samun riba?
panel.right_h: Ba kasafai ake yin oda ba

say: Ƙwaƙwalwar wasa tana da babban gefe amma tallace-tallace kaɗan ne, don haka ɗaukar shi mafi kyau kuma ku ba da shawarar shi. Kare ba shi da farin jini kuma ƙarancin gefe. Cire ko sake fasalin shi. Maimaita wannan kowane wata ko biyu, saboda farashin yana canzawa da sauri.

panel.heading: Wadanne abinci ne suka fi samun riba?
panel.right_h: Ba kasafai ake yin oda ba

say: Yi rijistar kasuwancin ku tare da CAC kuma shigar da dawowar shekara-shekara. Fakitin kayayyaki kamar gaurayawan kayan yaji suna buƙatar rajistar NAFDAC, don haka a sami buƙatu daga NAFDAC kai tsaye, ba wakilan kafofin watsa labarun ba.
Tambayi karamar hukumar ku game da izinin lafiya. Ajiye mai kaya, zafin jiki, tsaftacewa da bayanan korafe-korafe, rubuta a lokacin.
Yi amfani da rubutacciyar yarjejeniya don kowane taron, kuma kada ku taɓa yin da'awar abinci yana maganin komai.
